notes.title: Summer Heat Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/e2f921e1c13f89e9c90bac11196d816017491f55.png
New Hero: Shroomella, the Mushroom Witch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/db97de09c26eec00d2662c365f96daff8c4aebcd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/1e9ba786c34f9e5ad37523afa32b032a23b23569.gif

We've worked with our friends over at Octosoft to bring Shroomella to Harvest Hero Origins!

Renaine  is an upcoming Action Platformer game about Aine, an immortal Phoenix Knight.

Shroomella is a Mushroom Shroom witch aiding Aine on her quest! She uses her variety of magical mushrooms to fight off the endless Grooble hordes. 


 Attack - Plant an explosive Bombshroom down in front of you!
 Blessing 1 - Gain the ability to kick Bombshrooms forward.
 Blessing 2 - Every 10th shroom planted is a Gigashroom, eating it will grant you temporary Gigantification!


Bomb!
Place a Bombshroom in front of enemy paths to blow them to smithereens!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/1e9ba786c34f9e5ad37523afa32b032a23b23569.gif

Kick!
If you miss their path, just kick your Bombshrooms at em!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/e01c7eb0c4e7e1d063ee154a34b379aaf43869ad.gif

Grow!
And if all else fails, eat a Gigashroom and stomp your enemies out!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770594/e376549e60e8adfbfda0658fc2037527e3726496.gif

And More!

Season 3 also begins today, climb to the top of the leaderboard and become the best!

On top of that, we're adding:

 A New Map
 2 New Cards
 2 New Enemies
 A revised story boss fight
